extracted.name: Brown Butter Chocolate Chip Cookies
extracted.description: I love this recipe. They are crispy and chewy at the same time. Please post pictures if you make them.
ingredient_lines: 1 tsp kosher salt or table sale
1 1/2 cup dark chocolate chips or your preference
instruction_lines: Brown the butter over medium heat. Set aside to cool
I'm a mixing bowl combine both sugars and browned butter and whisk until combined
Add eggs and flavoring and whisk until combined
Add dry ingredients- flour, baking soda, cornstarch, salt. Don't mix yet
Add chocolate chips and pecans. Here you will need to fold Ingredients until combined well and cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least an hour before baking.
Scoop cookies onto cookie sheet lined with parchment paper. Bake on 350 for 9-10 minutes if making larger cookies and 6-7 minutes if making smaller cookies
